args.summary: Following the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1, the service began failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback was executed and verified successfully across all regions; v2.3.1 needs investigation before any re-deploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the last healthy version**: From the deployment history, **v2.3.0** was the most recent release marked healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc only ran in staging and was also unhealthy).
3. **Rolled back**: v2.3.0 was deployed to all production regions and verified — the service is now healthy with the error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: `INC-0001` is open for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the current healthy state. The on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production. The v2.3.1 code itself should be investigated before any future re-deploy.
